tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Native window canvas (FrogCanvas, white .955 / .118) under the transcript and composer. Text: fg, muted.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Web page ground (frog.toys). Text: fg 15.6:1 / 15.4:1, muted 4.7:1 / 6.7:1.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Web cards, settings groups, the account card, text field fill. Text: fg, muted (5.1:1 / 6.1:1).

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Inset wells inside a card: code, previews, the meter track.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on card and bg (decorative; never the only edge of a control).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control edges: the composer and text field stroke (primary at 14% on canvas).

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: hoverPlate: the 7px-radius plate under a plain button on hover (primary 8%).

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, card, canvas, well.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: detail lines, captions, composer controls, on bg and card.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled glyphs only (2.3:1 / 3.1:1, below text contrast: never for content).

tokens.name: frog
tokens.usage: The brand green (Color.frog = AccentColor): prominent buttons, focus ring, send glyph, links. As text only 24px+ in light (3.2:1 on bg).

tokens.name: on-frog
tokens.usage: Text on a frog fill. Light white is 3.4:1, under 4.5:1: keep labels semibold 13px+ and flagged; dark 8.8:1.

tokens.name: frog-pad
tokens.usage: Tinted pad behind the mark and selected rows on the web.

tokens.name: place-local
tokens.usage: Models on your own hardware (Color.place cloud: false, system blue): ModelPill name and icon. 4.0:1 on card light: semibold.

tokens.name: place-cloud
tokens.usage: Models in the cloud and Frog Cloud (system green): ModelPill, cloud.fill glyph, plan badge text. 1.9:1 on its badge in light: flagged.

tokens.name: badge-bg
tokens.usage: Plan badge capsule fill (.green.opacity(0.18)).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Web warnings and destructive emphasis. 4.2:1 on bg light: bold or 17px+ only.

tokens.name: notice
tokens.usage: Native orange: the unavailable banner's triangle and stroke. Icon only, never text.

tokens.name: notice-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the unavailable banner (orange 9%).

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: WEB ONLY: Liquid Glass approximation fill under backdrop-filter. Text on it: fg.

tokens.name: glass-fallback
tokens.usage: WEB ONLY: opaque fill when backdrop-filter is unsupported or prefers-reduced-transparency.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: WEB ONLY: the inner specular edge of a glass panel (inset 1px).

tokens.name: mark-skin
tokens.usage: Locked mark palette (FrogFace): skin. Mark only.

tokens.name: mark-spot
tokens.usage: Locked mark palette: spots. Mark only.

tokens.name: mark-ink
tokens.usage: Locked mark palette: eyes and smile ink.

tokens.name: mark-paper
tokens.usage: Locked mark palette: eye highlights.

tokens.name: icon-ground
tokens.usage: App icon ground, top of its gradient (0.090, 0.102, 0.094).

tokens.name: icon-ground-deep
tokens.usage: App icon ground, bottom (0.059, 0.067, 0.059).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: .body: transcript text, the account card's name, the composer field.

tokens.name: space-hair
tokens.usage: TurnSpace.Inset.hair; badge vertical (1px in code).

tokens.name: space-tight
tokens.usage: Inset.tight: icon to label in pills.

tokens.name: space-snug
tokens.usage: Inset.snug: badge gap, name to badge.

tokens.name: space-row
tokens.usage: Inset.row: control row gaps.

tokens.name: space-card
tokens.usage: Inset.card: icon to text in the account card, banner padding.

tokens.name: space-roomy
tokens.usage: Inset.roomy = Card.padding; composer vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-field
tokens.usage: Composer horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-icon
tokens.usage: Inset.icon: the icon column.

tokens.name: space-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheet padding (KeySheet), TurnSpace.top.

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: TurnSpace.gutter: transcript and composer side gutter.

tokens.name: radius-plate
tokens.usage: hoverPlate under plain buttons, ModelPill.

tokens.name: radius-nested
tokens.usage: Card.nestedRadius: cards inside cards, web .doc.

tokens.name: radius-banner
tokens.usage: Notice banners, web palette.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Card.radius: transcript cards.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Composer field, command palette glass, web cards.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Glass panels (sessions, changes, pond brief).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Capsules: badges, glass pills, CTA.

tokens.name: shadow-cta
tokens.usage: Web prominent button (site .download).

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Web floating menus and palettes (.pal).

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: Web toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: WEB ONLY glass panel: glass-edge plus shadow-float.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: TurnSpace.measure: transcript column max width.

tokens.name: prompt-width
tokens.usage: TurnSpace.promptWidth: user prompt bubble max.

tokens.usage: FrogFace in the activity pill.
